31.title: Slope-scaled polygon offset is wrong under W buffering

33.title: Image blit: BlitBeyondWidth diverges by 284k px (not an overlap case)

35.title: Projective shadow comparison is off by a thin band in every 3* family, independent of depth format

36.title: Line and polygon smoothing are not applied; every -ls/-ps 3D_primitive test differs on its edges

40.title: Cube-face selection differs on the left cube's silhouette column in 24 dot-product cubemap tests

41.title: nv2a: RADIAL fog gen mode with a vertex program fully fogs every quad on hardware

42.title: nv2a: the fog output register keeps its last value when a vertex program does not write it

43.title: Signed blend equations (FUNC_ADD_SIGNED, FUNC_REVERSE_SUBTRACT_SIGNED) are treated as plain add and reverse-subtract

44.title: 2D_BorderTex_SZ flakes: a band of padding texels inside the B32x32 swatch on some runs

46.title: PROJECT2D shadow maps compare against a literal 0.0, with no depth reference

48.title: Blend surface: two draws land on the region and the wrong one survives; only the O format needs a forced alpha

49.title: Viewport: two fractional offsets (-7/16 and +9/16) differ by 698 px each, none of it one-step

50.title: Blend tests: DrawColorAndAlphaStack's stack is wrong on 1,567 of 1,568 captures; mechanism unknown, not a reversal

51.title: Texture cubemap: DOT_STR_3D fetches a corner texel on silicon, picked by two dot-product signs

52.title: Depth buffer: four independent defects on eight cells, one fixed, and the compression axis is inert

53.title: Vertex program with LIGHTING_ENABLE: the programmable path emits the constant term but no light loop (6 captures)

54.title: tcg: all guest memory barriers are elided under XBOX, and device threads read guest RAM with bare loads
